messages.reasoning_content: Current code: end splitting not handled — need to move end backward if splits pair, and reject nonempty read that can't progress. Current `need(end>offset||offset===text.length,...)` rejects when end===offset (max_chars>=1 means end>offset unless... actually end>=offset+1, so that need is odd). Contract: reject interior start; move interior end backward; reject nonempty read that cannot progress without splitting. So: if end<text.length && splitPair(end) → end--; need(end>offset, 'inspection-range-splits-unicode') — handles max_chars=1 starting at surrogate-pair boundary? offset can't be interior; if offset is start of pair and max_chars=1, end=offset+1, split, end-- → end==offset → reject. Good.
